title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant / Crawley / Salary £30,000 - £34,000 / Study Support / Excellent Benefits / Permanent Role

Accounts Assistant Benefits
- Excellent holiday package
- Room for training and development
- Amazing benefits
- Study support
- Great location

Accounts Assistant Role Overview

A great opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join our clients finance team based in Crawley. This is a varied position offering exposure to all aspects of transactional finance, including purchase ledger, sales ledger, bank reconciliations, credit control and month-end support. Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the finance function.

Accounts Assistant Responsibilities:
- Process purchase ledger invoices, matching, coding and posting accurately.
- Raise and process sales invoices in a timely manner.
- Allocate customer receipts and supplier payments.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve invoice queries.
- Assist with credit control, chasing outstanding payments and maintaining aged debt.
- Process payment runs via BACS and online banking.
- Perform daily bank reconciliations and post cash transactions.
- Assist with month-end procedures, including journal postings and reconciliations.
- Prepare and reconcile accruals and prepayments where required.
- Support the preparation of VAT returns.
- Produce ad hoc reports using Excel and accounting software.
- Provide administrative support to the wider finance team.

Accounts Assistant Experience Required
- Previous experience working in an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role.
- Strong understanding of purchase ledger and sales ledger processes.
- Experience of bank reconciliations and supplier statement reconciliations.
- Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and Pivot Tables (desirable).
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- A proactive and positive approach with strong problem-solving abilities.
- AAT qualified or currently studying towards AAT (desirable but not essential).

Why Should you Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive and growing business where you'll play a key role within the finance team. Offering genuine career development and exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities. This position is ideal for someone looking to build on their existing experience and take the next step in their finance career. Apply for immediate consideration! Alternatively, send your CV directly to

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all applicants of identity, personal characteristics, or background.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant - Crawley (hybrid) - 6 month FTC - £30-35k

My client is looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Administrator to join their Finance team on an initial 6-month fixed term contract. The role is to provide the team through a busy period of change and there is the possibility of it going permanent. Hybrid working requires min 2 days per week on site.

You will be responsible for processing supplier invoices, payments and expenses, maintaining strong supplier relationships, and ensuring all Accounts Payable activities are completed accurately, efficiently and in line with company controls.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, expenses and payment runs.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve queries.
- Monitor AP inboxes and maintain supplier records.
- Support month-end activities, audits and reporting.
- Ensure compliance with financial controls and company policies.
- Assist with system improvements, automation projects and process enhancements.
- Build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

About You
- Proven Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger experience.
- Strong understanding of AP processes and controls.
- Experience with ERP finance systems.
- Strong Excel and reconciliation skills.
- Excellent communication, organisation and problem-solving abilities.
- Detail-oriented, proactive and able to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

For more information, please apply today as my client is looking for an ASAP start!

title: Crewing Operations Coordinator
description:
Crewing Operations Coordinator
- Location: Crawley, West Sussex
- Job Type: Fixed Term Contract
- Salary: Negotiable

Are you looking to join a dynamic team working within a leading international company, supporting corporate, sport, broadcast and entertainment industries. As a Crewing Operations Coordinator, you will be responsible for the coordination and booking of onsite crew for all live events in a professional, effective and timely manner. This role is ideal for someone with exceptional relationship management and customer service skills, along with a high level of time management and attention to detail.

Day-to-Day duties of the Role:
- Source and book technical crew for multiple events worldwide, including negotiation of rates and expenses.
- Plan and arrange complex crew travel arrangements, including flights, trains, car hire, and transfers.
- Manage the application and processing of VISA, work permits, or second passport requirements.
- Handle event accreditation processes and maintain accurate internal records.
- Manage and maintain on-site engineer and freelancer diaries on our in-house system, Rental Point.
- Monitor and process Purchase Orders and ensure timely reconciliation of all invoices and purchase orders for travel and expenses.
- Assess freelance crew at the time of engagement against IR35 tax rules and maintain accurate internal records.
- Source and process new freelancers through the contractor approval process.
- Update and maintain Public Liability Insurance (PLI) data and crew data including passports, certification, and company status.
- Assist in the administration and booking of all on-site crew training and maintain the crew training matrix.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Ability to plan and prioritise workloads and multi-task under pressure.
- Strong and confident communication skills with positive interpersonal abilities.
- Proven track record in customer service and meticulous attention to detail.
- General computer literacy with good working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages.
- Pro-active and self-motivated with the ability to use initiative and escalate issues when appropriate.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary package.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Work in a dynamic and supportive environment.
- Be part of a company that values innovation, integrity, and a one-team approach.

Apply online now to be considered for this vacancy.
